full_name: Lisandro Alonso | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Filmmaker (Argentina)
bio: Lisandro Alonso is an Argentine film director and screenwriter. In a style that blends the traditions of documentary and narrative film, Alonso focuses on solitary individuals as a lens through which to explore loneliness.
